---
title: "GC-MS/FID Report"
format:
  pdf:
    papersize: letter
    geometry: margin=0.6in
    fontsize: 9pt
params:
  result_rds: ""
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r setup}
library(knitr)
result <- readRDS(params$result_rds)
info <- result$quant$info
s <- result$summary
t <- s$totals
q <- s$qc
```

## Total Compound Report

```{r header}
kable(data.frame(
  ` ` = c("Sample ID", "Sample Name", "Project Code", "Report Date", "Analyst"),
  `  ` = c(info$sample_id, info$sample_name, info$project_code,
           format(info$report_date, "%Y-%m-%d"), info$analyst),
  `   ` = c("Density", "Methanol", "Water", "GC Recovery", "Total:"),
  `    ` = c(sprintf("%.4f g/mL", info$density),
             sprintf("%.1f wt. %%", info$methanol_wt_pct),
             sprintf("%.1f wt. %%", info$water_wt_pct),
             sprintf("%.1f wt. %%", t$gc_recovery),
             sprintf("%.1f wt. %%", t$total)),
  `     ` = c("Aligned Peaks", "Unique Peaks", "Total Peaks",
              "Interpolated Peaks", "MS/FID Offset Time"),
  `      ` = c(q$aligned_peaks, q$unique_peaks, q$total_peaks,
               q$interpolated_peaks, sprintf("%.3f min", q$ms_fid_offset)),
  check.names = FALSE
), booktabs = TRUE, align = "llllll")
```

```{r peaks}
# Analyst-facing QC columns are omitted from the client PDF.
tbl <- moosaic::total_compound_table(result)
qc_cols <- c("MS Match Score", "Area (MS)", "FID/MS Ratio",
             "Rank Confidence", "RI Delta", "Final Score")
kable(tbl[, !names(tbl) %in% qc_cols], booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE,
      digits = 3)
```

\newpage

## Summary Report

```{r summary-header}
kable(data.frame(
  ` ` = c("Sample ID", "Sample Name", "Project Code", "Report Date", "Analyst",
          "Density (g/mL)"),
  `  ` = c(info$sample_id, info$sample_name, info$project_code,
           format(info$report_date, "%Y-%m-%d"), info$analyst,
           sprintf("%.4f", info$density)),
  check.names = FALSE
), booktabs = TRUE)
```

```{r families}
fam <- rbind(
  data.frame(`Compound Type` = s$families$compound_type,
             `Total Amount (wt. %)` = sprintf("%.1f", s$families$wt_pct),
             check.names = FALSE),
  data.frame(`Compound Type` = c("Methanol (external)", "Water", "TOTAL"),
             `Total Amount (wt. %)` = sprintf("%.1f", c(t$methanol, t$water, t$total)),
             check.names = FALSE)
)
kable(fam, booktabs = TRUE)
```

```{r elements}
el <- data.frame(
  Element = c(s$elements$element, "Sum"),
  `Calculated wt. %` = sprintf("%.2f", c(s$elements$wt_pct, t$element_sum)),
  check.names = FALSE
)
kable(el, booktabs = TRUE)
```

**NOTE:** Elemental values are wt% sum of all GC determined compounds and does not include H~2~O

**NOTES:**

```{r notes, results='asis'}
notes <- moosaic:::.summary_notes()
cat(paste0(seq_along(notes), ". ", notes), sep = "\n\n")
```
